title: Acceptance, Warranty and Assessment Credit Terms by Class — Professional Services Projects
content:
For Professional Services Projects, each engagement class sets the acceptance window, the number of documented rejections before escalation, the warranty period, and the credit an accepted assessment earns against a follow-on statement of work.

| Figure | Assessment Engagement | Quick Start Project | Standard Project | Advanced Project | Major Project | Strategic Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Business days after acceptance is requested within which the client must sign acceptance or a documented rejection, else acceptance is deemed | 5 | 5 | 5 | 10 | 10 | 15 |
| Documented rejections after which the dispute is escalated to the delivery director instead of another remediation cycle | 2 | 2 | 2 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Calendar days after acceptance during which defects against the statement of work are fixed at no charge | 30 | 30 | 30 | 60 | 90 | 90 |
| Share of an Assessment Engagement fee credited against an implementation statement of work signed within the credit period of its acceptance (percent) | 100 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Days after an assessment's acceptance within which its fee may be credited to a follow-on statement of work | 90 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Reading the terms

- The credit share and the credit period are figures of the Assessment Engagement class: they belong to the accepted assessment whose fee is credited. The implementation classes list 0 for both.
- The acceptance window is counted in business days; the warranty and the credit period are counted in calendar days.

Hypothetical illustration: an Advanced Project allows 10 business days for the client's signed acceptance or documented rejection, escalates after 3 documented rejections, and carries a 60-day warranty.
